player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jɛgɛ {player_id} ye JoJoJoin, ka tɛmɛn dɛmɛn 5x5 la, ka sɛri 0-24.
Kɔnɔ kɔ, a ye a ma ka kɛmɛ sɔrɔ dɛmɛn kɔnɔ, nɔgɔ ' [12] '.
I NA GASE by getting sɔrɔ si naani sɔrɔ, — sɔrɔ si naani fila tɛmɛn kɔnɔ, tɛmɛn ɲɛ, walima kɔnɛ.
Kɔmɔ Jɛgɛ {player_id} i ye '{symbol}'; a ka jɛgɛ kɛlɛ ye '{opponent_symbol}'.
